description: Build a depth-driven GPU POP scatter field: consumes a depth/mask TOP and uses lookup_texture_pop to sample depth for displacement/scatter proxies (and optionally color). When depth_top_path is omitted, auto-spins-up a setup_segmentation MediaPipe chain inside the container and uses its mask Null TOP as the depth source. Scatter modes: 'displace' applies a uniform depth-scale proxy, 'emit' adds an emission-like jitter scatter proxy, 'both' does both. Forward-compatible: pass create_depth_from_2d (Depth Anything, W4) output as depth_top_path. NOTE: POPs are Experimental — op types and par names are fail-forward, probe on a live TD. Returns a JSON block with container path, depth source info, controls, warnings, and unverified probe record.

color_by_depth.description: When true, copies sampled RGBA into POP Color attribute via a second lookup_texture_pop (near = bright / far = dark).

depth_scale.description: Multiplier on the depth-driven displacement amount along +Z for displace/both scatter modes. Exposed as DepthScale knob when that displacement proxy is active.

depth_top_path.description: Absolute path of an existing depth/mask TOP (luminance = depth, bright = near by default). When omitted, the tool auto-spins-up a setup_segmentation chain inside the container and uses its mask Null TOP as the depth source. Future W4: pass create_depth_from_2d output here.

expose_controls.description: Build the live artist knobs panel for the active depth field controls.

invert_depth.description: Treat dark as near instead of bright. Implemented via Level TOP invert on a proxy feed.

name.description: Name for the self-contained container created under parent_path.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path where the depth-pop-field container is created.

particle_density.description: Approximate point count fed to pointgeneratorPOP.numpoints (100–500 000).

point_size.description: Render TOP point size, exposed as PointSize knob.

scatter_mode.description: 'displace' = uniform depth-scale proxy on the point cloud; 'emit' = emission-like scatter jitter around the sampled depth field; 'both' = depth-scale proxy + scatter jitter. True depth-weighted birth is unverified.

spin.description: Y-rotation of the field in deg/sec, animated via transformPOP ry expression. Exposed as Spin knob.

name: create_depth_pop_field
title: Create depth-driven POP field
